notes: Single document (CUNY system Academic Integrity Policy). Main disagreements: phase for set-up and sanction items (before-course vs course-start vs when-misuse), resolved by what the sentence does (syllabus and orientation communicate expectations, subscribing to a detection service is set-up, sanctions are when-misuse); modality and stance for citation clauses (must vs must-not, restrict vs permit), resolved by wording and by treating cited AI use as permitted; actor for the appeal right (student) and the mission rationale (admin); type P56 vs P44 for the mission sentence (P44) and P09 vs P04 for the delegation sentence (P04). Only-A unit dropped: a P19 duplicate of the P06 unit on the same sentence. Only-A units kept: unauthorized-use-is-plagiarism, record retention purpose, reduced-grade penalty, no-sanction-if-no-violation, colleges must be consistent. Only-B units kept: graduate-student violations as substantial, destroy file material, colleges may adopt procedures. Both coders agreed on the delegates stance.
